title: Soil & Composting: How to Compost
welcome_lead: Turn kitchen scraps into rich food for the garden.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: composting, greens, browns, heap.

concepts.def: Dry waste like leaves and cardboard.
Mix in air by turning the pile.

walkthroughs.body_html: A good compost mixes about 50/50 greens and browns. Greens add nitrogen and moisture; browns add carbon and air spaces.
Bacteria and fungi (decomposers) eat the mix. The heap warms up, even on cold days. Worms help speed it along.
Every few weeks, aerate by turning the heap with a fork. Air helps the decomposers and stops smells.
